# BYZ scope: sum of finance units over all themes, clamped to +-10% tax efficiency (20 units of 0.5%).
oe_theme_fin_units_sum = {
    value = 0
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes has_variable = oe_theme_tier_4 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_tier_4 = 0 } add = -1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_tier_4 = 2 } add = 1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_tier_4 = 3 } add = 2 }
    }
    min = -20
    max = 20
}
